verdict: Ads are running and converting — but lead data is not coming through.
narrative: In the last 28 days, Google Ads delivered 137 clicks and recorded 10 conversions on $916.71 in spend, so the ads themselves are working. However, zero leads are showing in your system — this is a tracking disconnect, not an ad performance failure. We have confirmed the issue and are actively repairing the connection so that every inbound lead is captured and visible. Once tracking is restored, you should see your pipeline reflect the actual activity your ads are already driving. Several planned milestones — including the financing page, Homer Glen branch, and Review Boost campaign — are also being moved forward in parallel.
